name: Nar Chunna; (The Bootana Hutta region, with Nar Chunna represented by the number 6)
description: Nar Chunna was a trade world located in the Nar Chunna system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Hestilic and Kor Utoradii systems. It was rumored that large amounts of priceless artifacts could be obtained on Nar Chunna.
